tools.name: find_email
tools.description: Find a person's work email from their name and their company's domain. Costs 30 credits ($0.03) only when the email is verified. not_found and couldnt_verify are free. Send first_name and last_name, or full_name, plus domain. Most lookups answer within seconds. If the search needs longer than wait_s

tools.name: get_find_email_result
tools.description: Read the result of an earlier find_email call by its id, for example one that was pending. Free. Set wait_seconds to wait for a search that is still running.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check whether an email address can receive mail. Answers valid, invalid or cant_confirm. Costs 4 credits ($0.004), 20 credits when the domain accepts all mail, and nothing when the answer is cant_confirm.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the account behind the API key: credit balance, prices and rate limits. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_email, get_find_email_result, verify_email · Private data: get_account · Public sink: find_email, get_find_email_result, verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_email, get_find_email_result, verify_email · Private data: get_account · Public sink: find_email, get_find_email_result, verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
